page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.3xlarge is a virtual machine configuration belonging to the shared instance family, equipped with 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 32.0 GB of memory. Driven by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, the system features 33 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction set extensions including AVX-512, AES, and FMA. This server profile provisions a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU, without bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators.

Benchmark results demonstrate a clear split between single-threaded execution and multi-threaded throughput. Single-core performance is limited, with Geekbench single-core scoring 936.0 and stress-ng single-core reaching 1106.89. In contrast, parallel capabilities maintain steady mid-range output, delivering a multi-core Geekbench score of 6692.0, a PassMark CPU score of 16949.88, and a stress-ng multi-core metric of 15839.14. Memory bandwidth reaches 106.51 GB/sec for large un-cached reads and 48.1 GB/sec for writes, supporting 21.48 million Redis SET operations per second.

Without integrated local disks, all persistent data depends entirely on network-attached storage options. The lower memory-to-core allocation provides an efficient compute-density profile for horizontal scale-out tasks that do not require high per-thread clocks or extensive RAM. Alibaba Cloud ecs.n1.3xlarge is appropriate for web serving tiers, parallel compilation pipelines, batch processing jobs, and microservices architectures.
